 OFFICIAL: BANANA BALL ADDS THIRD DATE AT ESL BALLPARK IN 2027
 Additional Game Scheduled for Thursday, July 1 
 By
 Andrew Westbrook
 October 31, 2026
 Facebook Share 
 X Share 
 Email 
 Copy Link

 ROCHESTER, NY – The Rochester Red Wings are excited to announce that BANANA BALL has added a third game to its highly anticipated visit to ESL Ballpark in 2027. The additional game, scheduled for Thursday, July 1, expands the event to three days, joining the previously announced games on Friday, July 2 and Saturday, July 3.
 The newly added July 1 game will appear on the official Banana Ball schedule beginning Monday, November 2. Fans selected through the lottery for the originally announced July 2 and 3 games will be contacted directly by the Savannah Bananas with additional information.
 Banana Ball combines fast-paced baseball with choreographed dances, music, and fan interaction to create an entertainment experience unlike traditional baseball. Featuring unique rules designed to keep the action moving, Banana Ball has attracted fans across the country with its high-energy atmosphere and emphasis on entertainment.
 A limited number of suites and hospitality spaces will be available for all three games. These premium spaces will be sold directly by the Rochester Red Wings and are separate from the Banana Ball Ticket Lottery. Fans interested in receiving additional information can complete the Banana Ball Suite Interest Form . 
 Additional event details will be announced at a later date.
